fact_text: Budget 2026 did not add any new tax on PSX dividends, capital gains or trading, while most companies' super tax was cut.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst judged Budget 2026 as macro-stable and growth-oriented, arguing that the federal government could afford tax cuts within its IMF-agreed fiscal targets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 cut the super tax on most companies from 10% to 8%, excluding oil and gas exploration, fertilizer and banking companies.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government promised to abolish the super tax on exporters, which would lower their effective tax rate from 39% to 29%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A lower corporate tax rate raises profit after tax, which in turn raises a company's fair value; this is the chain the analyst used to read the budget for each sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tax collected above the agreed federal target is not shared with provinces, so the analyst argued the Centre gains Rs 700 to 800 billion even if the target is missed, which creates room for tax cuts.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 exempts brownfield expansion projects at the listed refineries from 18% sales tax on imported machinery.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: National Refinery and Attock Refinery each plan roughly $500 million of expansion, so the machinery tax exemption could save them about $100 million, improving upgrade feasibility.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government said the petroleum development levy on petrol and diesel would average about Rs 80 per litre; the higher budget figure reflects volume growth and earlier months below that level.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Chemicals blended into diesel and petrol were sold untaxed; the budget closed this loophole by imposing federal excise duty on those fuels equal to the petroleum levy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A heavy tax on local furnace oil forces refiners to export it at a loss; the analyst said this was a structural drag on refiner policy that is now easing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refiners earn more when diesel margins are strong, and a lower super tax on refiners adds to the profit benefit, in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Advance tax on property transactions was halved, so buyers pay 1.25% and sellers pay 2.75%, and the late-filer concept for property tax was removed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The annual 1% tax on the FBR value of additional properties owned, called the 7E tax, was abolished.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 allocated about Rs 71 billion to the housing finance scheme, which offers 5% interest over 10 years for home loans up to Rs 10 million.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lower property taxes and cheaper housing finance are expected to revive construction, so demand for cement, steel and glass could exceed the prior year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Customs duty on coal, a main cement input, may fall from 5% to 0%, but the detailed duty schedule had not been released when the analyst spoke.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: In the analyst's reasoning, northern cement plants offer better long-term returns than southern ones, because they sell mainly locally and are shielded from imports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Southern cement makers that export could also benefit if the export super tax is abolished, since their export earnings would no longer carry it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Relaxing the restriction on converting residential plots to commercial use in Karachi could lift local cement demand in the south.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lower oil prices after the Iran-US conflict eases tend to pull coal prices down gradually, which can reduce the energy cost of cement makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Steel's sales tax was replaced by a per-unit sales tax on electricity used, which makes it harder for undocumented steel makers to avoid tax.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Steel faces a risk that import duties will be cut under the IMF agreement, with an effect in two to three years, which can lower the realised value of steel makers' output.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The concessionary sales tax on plug-in hybrids of about 8.5% and on hybrids of 8.5% to 12.5% expired on 30 June 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A new five-year auto policy setting duties and sales tax on plug-in hybrids and EVs was expected within weeks; without it, hybrid sales tax could rise to 18% to 25%, a negative for the segment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 extended for one year the 1% sales tax on EVs with batteries under 50 kWh and set the sales tax on EV bikes, rickshaws, buses and trucks at 1%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 raised federal excise duty on expensive imported cars and applied it to EVs priced above Rs 20 million.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst speculated that Indus Motor could launch a plug-in hybrid version of the Corolla locally if the government backs PHEVs with a five-year policy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The 0.25% final income tax on IT exports was extended for three years, giving the sector a fixed tax regime over that period.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: IT exports from freelancers and listed companies are around $5.5 to 6 billion a year and, in the analyst's view, could reach about $10 billion within three years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Advance tax on foreign online payments made by credit card, used for international software tools, was cut from 5% to 0.5%, saving about Rs 10 to 11 per dollar spent.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A 5% tax now applies to earnings from YouTube and other social media platforms for creators and digital earners.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Systems Limited may benefit from the IT tax changes, but its heavy exports to the Middle East make that region's economic recovery from the oil shock a key risk to track.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Interloop is a high-margin exporter that would be a major beneficiary of abolishing the export super tax, since its after-tax profit would rise as the rate falls from 39% to 29%, in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The minimum turnover tax on exports rose from 1% to 1.25% and the advance tax on exports was removed; this is negative for thin-margin exporters because the minimum tax is payable regardless of profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Working capital loans for exporters are to be priced at 4.5%, with about Rs 80 to 90 billion set aside in the budget, which lowers exporters' finance costs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The 9% surcharge on high salaried incomes was abolished, which raises after-tax salaries for that group.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Higher disposable income for salaried people spreads demand across sectors: FMCG purchases, completion of unfinished homes and new home building all rise, in the analyst's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pharma companies' super tax was reduced like other companies, and their export earnings may be fully exempt from super tax.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lower oil prices make oil-based chemical inputs for paracetamol cheaper, which the analyst saw as an extra tailwind for paracetamol makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 changed customs duties on only 92 items, so the analyst expected limited duty impact on chemicals, with the chemical-specific duty schedule still pending.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: More than half of chemical companies use grid electricity, and the annual grid tariff reset moves from 1 July to 1 January 2027 under this budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 was a non-event for fertilizer because its super tax was not cut; the analyst still expected stable earnings and continuing dividends.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Budget 2026 was also a non-event for banks because their super tax was not cut; the analyst expected deposit growth to continue and valuations to benefit from a better economy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst observed that investing in PSX during past oil-shock sell-offs has historically produced strong returns over the following few years, though this is not guaranteed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Budget 2026 for PSX Investors' (YouTube transcript, undated)
